positions.as_written: Take the mechanism and the ability to weightbear, because an inability to weightbear in a child is a stronger sign than in an adult.
Assess the range gently, and stop at the point of guarding rather than pushing through it.
Defer stress testing until a radiograph has been seen if the physeal tenderness is convincing, and record that decision.
